## Quarto

Quarto enables you to weave together content and executable code into a finished document. To learn more about Quarto see <https://quarto.org>.

## Running Code

When you click the **Render** button a document will be generated that includes both content and the output of embedded code. You can embed code like this:

```{r}
1 + 1
```

You can add options to executable code like this

```{r}
#| echo: false
2 * 2
```

The `echo: false` option disables the printing of code (only output is displayed).

Ejercicio 1 - El paso previo a across()

```{r}

alumnos <- data.frame(
  nombre = c("Ana", "Luis", "Juan"),
  matematica = c(8, 6, 9),
  historia = c(7, 8, 5),
  geografia = c(9, 7, 10)
)

```

```{r}
alumnos |> mutate(p_matematica = (matematica / 10) * 100,
                  p_historia = (historia / 10) * 100,
                  p_geografia = (geografia/10) * 100 
                  )

```

```{r}
alumnos2 <-  alumnos |> mutate(across(c(matematica, historia, geografia),
                                      .fns = \(.x) (.x /10) * 100,
                                      .names = "p_{.col}"
                                      )
                               )
```

```{r}
paises <- data.frame(
  pais = c("A", "B", "C"),
  hombres = c(100, 80, 120),
  mujeres = c(110, 90, 130)
)

paises |> mutate(p_hombres =  hombres / (hombres + mujeres) *100,
                 p_mujeres =  mujeres / (hombres + mujeres) *100 
                 )
paises2 <- paises |> mutate(  across (.cols = c(hombres, mujeres), 
                                      .fns = \(.x) (.x/ (hombres+mujeres)*100) 
                                      .names = "p_{.col}")
                              )

```

```{r}
alumnos <- data.frame(
  nombre = c("Ana", "Luis", "Carla", "Pedro", "Sofía"),
  edad = c(19, 22, 18, 25, 21),
  nota = c(8, 5, 9, 6, 4)
)
```

```{r}
alumnos <- alumnos |> mutate(
  resultado = if_else(nota >= 6, "Aprobado", "Desaprobado"
                      )
) 
```


```{r}
#case when
alumnos <- alumnos |> mutate(categoria_edad = 
                    case_when(
                      edad < 20 ~ "Joven", 
                      edad >= 20 & edad <= 24 ~ "Adulto joven", 
                      edad >= 25 ~ "Adulto" 
                      )
                    )
```

```{r}
#between

library(dplyr)

alumnos <- alumnos |> mutate(categoria_edad = 
                    case_when(
                      edad < 20 ~ "Joven", 
                      between(edad, 20, 24) ~ "Adulto joven", 
                      edad >= 25 ~ "Adulto", 
                      TRUE ~ "Edad no válida"
                    )
                  )
```


```{r}
alumnos2 <- data.frame(
  nombre = c("Ana", "Luis", "Carla"),
  nota_matematica = c(8, 6, 9),
  nota_historia = c(7, 8, 5),
  nota_geografia = c(9, 7, 10)
)
```

```{r}
alumnos2 <-  alumnos |> mutate(across(
  .cols = starts_with("nota"), 
  .fns = \(.x) (.x /10) * 100,
  .names = "p_{.col}"
  )
  )
```


```{r}
personas <- data.frame(
  nombre = c("Ana", "Luis", "Carla", "Pedro"),
  edad = c(19, 34, 22, 51),
  ingreso = c(500000, 850000, 620000, 1200000),
  gasto = c(300000, 600000, 400000, 800000)
)
options(scipen = 999)

```

```{r}
personas <- personas|>
  mutate(situacion = 
           case_when(
             ingreso > gasto ~ "Superavit",
             ingreso < gasto ~ "Deficit",
             ingreso == gasto ~ "Equilibrio"
             )
         )

```

```{r}
hogares <- data.frame(
  hogar = 1:4,
  ingreso_anual = c(6000000, 8400000, 4800000, 12000000),
  gasto_anual = c(4800000, 7200000, 5400000, 9600000)
)
```

```{r}
hogares |>
  mutate(
    across(
      .cols = ends_with("_anual"),
      .fns = \(x) x / 12,
      .names = "nuevo_{.col}"
    )
  ) |>
  rename_with(
    ~ str_replace(.x, "nuevo_(.*)_anual", "\\1_mensual"),
    .cols = starts_with("nuevo_")
  )

#across no acepta funciones como str_replace entonces hay que hacerlo end dos pasos

```
